subject: Crestview: request to pause demo while they shift roadmap
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@crestview.ai>, Anya Diaz <anya.diaz@crestview.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Crestview — intro demo + next steps

Hi Samir / Anya,

Great to connect on the call yesterday. Per our discussion I put together a short walkthrough of how Redwood Inference can reduce per-token cost while keeping latency predictable for customer-facing features — attached is the discovery deck and a draft mutual action plan.

Can you confirm whether Oct 12 at 10:00 AM PT still works for a 45-minute demo + technical Q&A? If that slot doesn’t work we can do Oct 14 or record a short technical walkthrough that you can circulate.

If it helps, I can also invite our infra lead (Dev) for the deep-dive on runtime/quantization options.

Attachments: Crestview-Discovery-Deck.pdf (slide deck), crestview-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Anya Diaz <anya.diaz@crestview.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Kapoor <samir@crestview.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crestview — intro demo + next steps

Ben — thanks for the follow-up and for the materials. The deck looks helpful.

Quick update from our side: our product leadership just re-scoped the Q4 roadmap and moved the inference/prototyping work onto the backburner. VP of Product is traveling through mid-October and the team is being reassigned to a feature launch.

Given that, we should pause the live demo for now. Can we park the MAP and revisit in early January when planning re-opens? If you have a short recorded walkthrough we can circulate internally in the meantime, that might help keep stakeholders informed without tying up calendars.

Appreciate the offer to include Dev — I’ll ping you once we have clarity on the product timeline.

Apologies for the shift — we definitely want to keep the conversation alive but timing is tight.

Best,
Anya Diaz
Head of Product Operations
Crestview
anya.diaz@crestview.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anya Diaz <anya.diaz@crestview.ai>, Samir Kapoor <samir@crestview.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crestview — intro demo + next steps

Thanks for the update, Anya — totally understood and congrats on the launch focus.

We can absolutely park the live session and move to a lightweight approach: I’ll send over a 12–15 minute recorded walkthrough of the demo and a one-page exec summary you can share with the product and engineering leads. That should keep things warm while you prioritize the launch.

A couple of quick asks so we handle this cleanly:
- Can you confirm January week of 4th (Jan 4–8) as a tentative time to re-evaluate? I’ll mark the opportunity for Q1 planning.
- Are there any compliance or procurement docs you’ll need in the meantime (SOC 2, data retention, KMS)? If so, Marissa can own the questionnaire and evidence collection.
- If the VP is traveling, would a short recorded technical session for engineers be helpful (we can include the infra notes from Dev)?

We’ll also keep the MAP draft editable — no need to sign until timing aligns. I’ll attach the recording and summary in a follow-up, and list a proposed nurture cadence (monthly check-ins + a Q1 planning touch).

Appreciate the honesty — happy to be flexible.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T16:33:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Crestview paused — guidance and next steps

Marissa / Dev — quick internal note on CRESTVIEW (DEAL-4821). Prospect has asked to pause the live demo due to a product sprint reallocation; they want to revisit early January.

Requests / proposed actions:
1) Marissa — can you flag this deal as "nurture" in HubSpot and attach the MAP draft; please also prepare SOC 2/Q&A packet so we can send proactively if they ask.
2) Dev — I’ll record a 12-minute technical walkthrough and include infra notes (quantization + KV-cache behavior) for their engineers; can you review by EOD Friday?
3) Commercial — do we want to offer a small trial credit or deferred kickoff incentive to keep them engaged? If so I’ll propose with the Q1 plan.

Goal: keep engagement warm without burning SE/AE calendar. I’ll schedule a tentative Q1 planning note (Jan 4–8) with a placeholder and send the recording this week.

Attachments referenced: Crestview-Discovery-Deck.pdf, crestview-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
